summary: V6.5 was fast-forwarded into main before the V6.6 branch was created. The first experiment uses consumed P10V actor evidence only as a development mechanism atlas, overlaps CPU loading with q0 GPU forward, and does not add hashes, checksums, fingerprints, broad smoke tests or regression matrices.

409 eligible actor-units produced 2045 paired clusters. Frozen q0 is exactly actor-blind in the representation-level pairs, while observable injected factors are perfectly separable and hazard invariant. The perfect certificate score is treated as construction capability, not natural-artifact generalization; P3 learned superiority remains locked without a fresh deterministic ceiling.

The independent certificate recomputed all decisions from observable factors and passed eight gates with exact Actor existence, identity, lifecycle and hazard-pair retention. Because the deterministic development denominator is already perfectly separated, learned P3 has no preregistered relative headroom and remains unexecuted; P4 now tests whether repair, rather than drop or abstain, preserves hazard events.

DROP and REPAIR both remove all injected factor violations, but DROP retains only half of hazard events; ABSTAIN preserves hazards but leaves all violations. REPAIR alone preserves hazards and identity while clearing violations. This remains a factor-level construction result, so the next diagnostic moves to disjoint natural actor-owned observed-FREE conflicts.

The disjoint legacy cohort contains 498 conflict and 393 clean actor-units. Actor-level support certificate recall is zero and q0 ranking is weak, proving that supported Actor existence does not validate every owned primitive. Literature search motivates a two-level instance-evidence head rather than Actor deletion or a replacement backbone.

The frozen low-capacity head improves P10X AUROC/AUPRC by 0.152365/0.133461 over the constant deterministic certificate and is above chance in all six evaluable scenes. The result supports a two-level certificate: existence stays deterministic while learned evidence only ranks local repair or abstention. V66-F01 remains recovering until an independent no-refit confirmation.

Without refit, the frozen P3L head reaches 0.761644/0.767165 AUROC/AUPRC on 581 actor-units and is above chance in all six independent scenes. V66-F01 closes through a two-level compiler rather than changing the deterministic certificate: existence remains protected while learned evidence ranks only local repair or abstention.

The compiler bakes 581 Actor states and 1.62M owned primitives into an eight-file 16.32MB package with complete Actor metadata, zero Actor removal, zero hidden-target fields, and no runtime model or hazard-conditioned existence gate. Because geometry is not mutated, P7 must measure fixed-budget conflict exposure rather than claim physical repair.
